name: Git Plugin for PieJFX
description: A Git integration plugin for PieJFX that enables repository management, version control operations, and streamlined Git workflows directly within the application.
author: Mario Mateas

name: Maven Plugin for PieJFX
description: A plugin that provides Maven project support for PieJFX, including project creation, lifecycle management, custom build command management and dependency visualizer.
author: Mario Mateas

description: A plugin that is capable of generating documentation files, such as Software Requirement Specification, Change Request, and Release Notes.
author: Mario Mateas

description: A plugin that provides agentic capability to PieJFX, offering a simple harness over OpenRouter models.
author: Mario Mateas
